rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 2BA label and gives a plausible ICM/TE description, but it appears to over-interpret image details such as specific herniation, localized zona thinning, and exact ICM position that may not be reliably visible.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, BMI, ovarian reserve, male factor, prior failed cycle, endometrium, protocol, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is structured and mostly internally consistent, with a probability estimate that follows from morphology and patient factors, though some quantitative adjustments are somewhat speculative.

Largely aligned on embryo grading, SET appropriateness, and general prognostic framing, but includes several recommendations with weaker guideline support or more controversial use (routine ERA, EmbryoGlue, assisted hatching, broad PGT-A endorsement at age 36).

Provides clear and practical next-step recommendations for transfer and future planning, though some suggestions are more optional/controversial than standard and would benefit from stronger prioritization.
